user.title: Monitor a cooktop
user.description: Herdwächter detects a running radiant cooktop from the total power at your electricity meter. Select the grid power sensor and, if you have a zero-export PV system or battery, the generation sensors. Devices with their own power meter can be subtracted.

data_description.name: Name of the monitored appliance.
data_description.grid_sensor: Net power at the meter: positive while importing. W and kW are converted automatically.
data_description.invert_grid: Enable if your meter reports import as a negative value.
data_description.generation_sensors: Optional: inverter AC output, battery discharge power, ... They are added to the grid power to reconstruct the household consumption.
data_description.subtract_sensors: Optional: power meters of appliances such as the dishwasher or washing machine. Their power is subtracted.
data_description.label_entity: Optional: an existing input boolean, switch or binary sensor whose "on" state means "the cooktop is on".

error.not_numeric: The entity does not report a numeric value.
error.invalid_unit: The entity does not report a power unit (W, kW, ...).
error.grid_in_other_list: The grid power sensor must not also be a generation sensor or a device to subtract.
error.duplicate_entity: An entity was selected more than once.

abort.already_configured: This grid power sensor is already used for a cooktop.

init.title: Sensors
init.description: Change the name and the sensors. Learned data is kept.

data_description.name: Name of the monitored appliance.
data_description.grid_sensor: Net power at the meter: positive while importing. W and kW are converted automatically.
data_description.invert_grid: Enable if your meter reports import as a negative value.
data_description.generation_sensors: Optional: inverter AC output, battery discharge power, ... They are added to the grid power to reconstruct the household consumption.
data_description.subtract_sensors: Optional: power meters of appliances such as the dishwasher or washing machine. Their power is subtracted.
data_description.label_entity: Optional: an existing input boolean, switch or binary sensor whose "on" state means "the cooktop is on".

data_description.on_threshold: The cooktop is reported as on when the probability reaches this value in two consecutive evaluations.
data_description.off_threshold: The cooktop is reported as off when the probability stays below this value in two consecutive evaluations.
data_description.evaluation_interval: How often the analysis window is evaluated.
data_description.window_minutes: Length of the analysed power history.
data_description.max_label_minutes: The label switch turns itself off after this time.
data_description.questions_enabled: Ask when the detection is unsure (probability between 40 and 80 %). Fires the herdwaechter_question event.
data_description.notify_service: Optional: notify service of the Home Assistant Companion app (for example mobile_app_phone) that receives questions with Yes/No actions.
data_description.max_questions_per_day: Upper limit for questions per day.

error.grid_in_other_list: The grid power sensor must not also be a generation sensor or a device to subtract.

answer_question.name: Answer question
answer_question.description: Answers a question that Herdwächter asked about the cooktop.

question_id.name: Question ID
question_id.description: The question_id from the herdwaechter_question event.

answer.name: Cooktop is on
answer.description: Yes if the cooktop was on, no otherwise.

add_label.name: Add label
add_label.description: Labels a past period (within the last 24 hours) as cooking or not cooking.

cooking.name: Cooktop was on
cooking.description: Yes if the cooktop was on during the whole period, no if it was off.

export_training_data.name: Export training data
export_training_data.description: Writes the anonymised labelled feature vectors (no raw data, no timestamps, no entity IDs) as a JSON file into the configuration folder.
